Add the Super Mario brothers LEGO Mario and LEGO Luigi or LEGO Peach figure (from sets 71439, 71440 or 71441 – sold separately) to this video game toy for an interactive seesaw balance challenge. Find building instructions for this set in the box or on the LEGO Super Mario app. The app also offers imaginative ideas for ways to build and play and is a safe platform for children to share their creations.
